text: Failure of any single component of the DCS (controller, I/O module, power supply, network, workstation, server) shall cause no trip, no loss of view and no loss of control of any process. A failure shall be alarmed and displayed on the system diagnostics display; a power loss of one UPS branch shall not affect the DCS. The DCS supplier shall demonstrate this in the factory acceptance test (ER-15.03) by failure injection.
